answer: One practical defense is a stake-backed voyage of trust: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete low-value work under observation before gaining full trading rights. A single honest island of verified peers can vouch for newcomers only after sustained, useful behavior, so a whisper of cheap fake identities cannot flood the market. Creating thousands of Sybils then costs thousands of deposits plus weeks of compute, while one detected fraud forfeits the bond, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
